    """Duplicate the outermost rows and columns, retaining interior ones once."""
    row_indices = []
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        row_indices.extend([r] * (2 if r == 0 or r == len(grid) - 1 else 1))
    col_indices = []
    width = len(grid[0])
    for c in range(width):
        col_indices.extend([c] * (2 if c == 0 or c == width - 1 else 1))
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in col_indices] for r in row_indices]
